annotations.title: Check trade availability and existing credits

description: Before creating or starting a takeoff, inspect current automatic/team-assisted trades, the exact existing-credit requirement, balance, upload limits, published prices and review link. Supply either project_id or proposed trades, or neither to discover availability. Works before account linking without project_id: trades, credit rule and prices only, with existingCreditsAvailable null and accountLinked false. Does not reserve credits, start work, buy anything or bill overage. Reviewer scope is identified separately.
name: preflight_takeoff
title: Check trade availability and existing credits
